## 0.5.3

- Fix SD initialization rejecting the app-data root's trailing slash, blocking
  saved snapshots and transfers larger than 4 KiB.
- Saved snapshots and the 20-entry limit are unchanged; no automatic execution.

## 0.5.2

- First independent catalog submission, with matching Mac companion downloads.
- Info and Downloads screens show the full version and a pinned release QR code.
- Optional read-only companion version query preserves protocol-4 compatibility.
- Clipboard, macros, 28 target layouts, timed repeats and standalone SD snapshots.
- Retains the 0.5.1 mouse-button release guard before movement and on Stop.
- No Ducker runtime, source, protocol or build dependency.

Physical focus/layout and multi-hour target validation remain open. Mouse input
is observable; no undetectability claim is made.
